VR.title: Meta Smart Glasses Daily Usage Tripled Year-Over-Year
VR.summary: Meta reported a year-over-year tripling of daily usage for its smart glasses, highlighting rapid growth in the consumer electronics market.

VR.title: Google Gemini Smart Glasses Launching In Fall To Take On Meta
VR.summary: Google's Gemini smart glasses, developed with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, are set to launch this fall, competing directly with Meta's offerings.

VR.title: Amplium Makes Room For A Wider Range Of Apple Immersive Video On Vision Pro
VR.summary: Amplium has launched a dedicated platform for immersive video content on Apple Vision Pro, featuring a variety of curated experiences.

VR.title: The Met's Immersive Future Extends Beyond The Museum
VR.summary: The Metropolitan Museum of Art is expanding its reach with a new immersive experience of the Temple of Dendur for Quest headsets and online.

VR.title: Apple Enables Third-party Motion Controllers & Tracked Accessories in visionOS 27
VR.summary: Apple's visionOS 27 now supports third-party motion controllers and tracked accessories, enhancing the functionality of the Vision Pro headset.

VR.title: Meta's New 'Navigator' System UI Finally Rolled Out To All Quest Headsets
VR.summary: Meta's new 'Navigator' system UI has been rolled out to all Quest headsets, improving user experience after extensive testing.

AI.title: Anthropic releases its first Mythos-class model Claude Fable
AI.summary: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5, its most powerful AI model to date, boasting exceptional performance across various tasks.

AI.title: Google won’t just admit it’s feeding YouTube creators to its music AI
AI.summary: Independent musicians are suing Google for allegedly using their YouTube songs to train its Lyria music AI without permission.

AI.title: Microsoft restricts Claude Fable for employees over data retention concerns
AI.summary: Microsoft is restricting the use of Anthropic's Claude Fable for employees due to concerns over new data retention policies.

AI.title: GM thinks EVs can help offset AI’s energy suck with vehicle-to-grid tech
AI.summary: General Motors announced new vehicle-to-grid capabilities for its EVs to help offset the energy demands of AI data centers.

AI.title: Google will save your Lens photos, Search Live recordings, and Translate audio for AI training
AI.summary: Google will now save user interactions with its services, including images and audio, under a new 'Search Services History' setting.

AI.title: Microsoft AI head calls out Anthropic for acting like Claude is conscious
AI.summary: Microsoft's AI head criticized Anthropic for suggesting its Claude model possesses consciousness, calling it a dangerous notion.

NFL.title: Report: Patrick Mahomes, Chiefs agree to first NFL deal worth over $500M
NFL.summary: Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs have agreed to a groundbreaking contract extension worth over $500 million, the largest in NFL history.

NFL.title: Dolphins C Aaron Brewer agrees to a three-year extension
NFL.summary: Dolphins center Aaron Brewer has signed a three-year contract extension worth $52.5 million, solidifying his role on the team.

NFL.title: Inside the Drake London deal
NFL.summary: The Falcons have secured wide receiver Drake London with a long-term contract, ensuring his presence in their future plans.

NFL.title: Cardinals CB Garrett Williams "for sure" has a chance to play Week 1
NFL.summary: Cardinals cornerback Garrett Williams is on track to return for Week 1 after positive updates on his recovery from a torn Achilles.

NFL.title: Eagles release Za'Darius Smith from reserve/retired list
NFL.summary: Za'Darius Smith has been released from the Eagles' reserve/retired list, opening the door for a potential return to the NFL.

NFL.title: Lamar Jackson being "challenged" by new offense, Declan Doyle
NFL.summary: Lamar Jackson is adapting to a new offensive scheme under a different coordinator, presenting a fresh challenge for the Ravens quarterback.
